purpose: Executable task-family catalog for SR2FPGA Codex implementation, benchmark planning, Line A/Line B selection, oracle readiness, skeleton strategy, and L0-L5 target policy.
source_notes: Aligned with current SR2FPGA code report: deterministic generator, System-HIS v1.2 checker, contract skeleton, L0-L3 tool loop, optional OpenXC7 L4, recorder/training views.
Aligned with SR2FPGA research spec: T0-T4 compressed curriculum, System-HIS v1.2, L0-L5 evaluation, L4 representative-subset policy, black-box testbench oracle discipline.
ArchXBench informs design-complexity pressure but its Level 0-6 is orthogonal to SR2FPGA T0-T4 and L0-L5.

module_difficulty.M2: protocol, memory, and basic interface module
module_difficulty.M3: numeric, stream, datapath, and mid-level protocol module
module_difficulty.M4: complex datapath, image, graphics, and optimization module
module_difficulty.M5: advanced system, accelerator, communication, and SoC module

project_difficulty.P4: complex integrated project or Paper② bridge

line_a.description: Official benchmark/eval set; quality first; all selected tasks require strong oracle, B_ref L0-L3 pass, frozen hidden/stress scenarios, and mutation-score gate.

line_b.description: Scalable training/trajectory data; scale first; run all selected tasks through L0-L3 by default; L4 only for small representative/QoR subsets.

l4_policy.commercial_reference_policy: Run Vivado only on TCAD subset if license permits; raw Vivado artifacts are internal_only.
